name: Mercury
description: The smallest and fastest planet, closest to the Sun
facts: Has extreme temperatures, no atmosphere, named after Roman messenger god

name: Venus
description: The hottest planet with a thick, toxic atmosphere
facts: Rotates backwards, brightest planet, surface hot enough to melt lead

name: Earth
description: Our home planet, the only known place with life
facts: Has one moon, 71% water, perfect conditions for life

name: Mars
description: The red planet, a target for future human exploration
facts: Has largest volcano in solar system, thin atmosphere, rust-colored surface

name: Jupiter
description: The largest planet, a massive gas giant with many moons
facts: Great Red Spot storm, 95 known moons, strongest magnetic field

name: Saturn
description: Famous for its beautiful rings made of ice and rock
facts: Most magnificent rings, 146 known moons, second largest planet

name: Uranus
description: An ice giant that rotates on its side
facts: Rotates on its side due to collision, blue-green color, thin ring system

name: Neptune
description: The most distant planet with strong winds and storms
facts: Fastest winds in solar system, deep blue color, coldest planetary atmosphere
